speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent viral illness, constant vertigo, and confirmed bilateral hearing loss, I suspect a central cause rather than a peripheral one like labyrinthitis. I need to rule out structural issues in the brainstem or cerebellum. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Head CT or MRI shows no acute abnormalities noted, specifically no signs of stroke or significant lesions.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRI is normal and positional testing was negative, this rules out stroke and BPPV. Your symptoms of constant vertigo, nausea, and bilateral hearing loss following a viral illness are most consistent with bilateral vestibulopathy or severe labyrinthitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Bilateral Vestibulopathy
